# The Cathedral and the Bazaar test fixture

This directory contains a Markdown conversion of *The Cathedral and the
Bazaar* by Eric Steven Raymond, version 3.0.

- Author: Eric Steven Raymond
- Copyright: 2000 Eric S. Raymond
- License: Open Publication License, version 2.0
- Canonical source:
  <http://www.catb.org/~esr/writings/cathedral-bazaar/cathedral-bazaar/>
- Source used for conversion:
  <http://www.catb.org/~esr/writings/cathedral-bazaar/cathedral-bazaar.xml>
- Conversion: Pandoc 3.11, DocBook to GitHub Flavored Markdown
- Preserved metadata: title, author, version, copyright, license, and abstract
